sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 261822 (per-site catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $25 a night per camping unit (up to 2 RVs, 2 tents, or 1 RV + 1 tent per site, each paying the fee); C-Loop sites 27-32 with the pavilion $140. Digital fee station (credit card) at the entrance kiosk. Dump at Black Sandy State Park $5 for White Sandy campers.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261822 (/rates Peak Season 2026-2028: RV Nonelectric $25, C-Loop 27-32 with Pavilion/Ramada $140; notice 'Each RV or tent is considered a camping unit and must pay the fee per unit') + https://www.blm.gov/visit/white-sandy-campground ('digital fee station (credit card reader)', 'RV dump station which is $5 to use if you are staying at White Sandy'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: BLM and recreation.gov both say 'Reservations are required at this site', but a recreation.gov notice also says 'First-come, first-served sites are available in this campground', so walk-up use is not recorded. 14 nights in any rolling 30 days. Reserved sites must be occupied every night; no changing sites or loops.

booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/white-sandy-campground ('Reservations are required at this site', 'Make your reservation today at recreation.gov') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261822 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 nights Rolling 30 Days; notices), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 32 sites with spacious, level gravel pads for RVs, travel trailers and tents. Recreation.gov's catalog lists 25 RV sites and the pavilion group site, all back-ins to 50 ft. East loop 24 sites; west loop is the 5-site group pavilion.

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/white-sandy-campground ('White Sandy is a 32-site campground that has spacious and level gravel parking pads that accommodate RVs, travel trailers and tents', 'The east loop has 24 campsites', 'The west loop encompasses the 5 campsites in the group pavilion') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (RV NONELECTRIC, Back-in, Max Vehicle Length 50), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261822 (notice 'There is no power available on site for campers and generators are only allowed from 7:00 a.m. until 10:00 p.m.') + per-site catalog (RV NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/white-sandy-campground ('There are vault toilets located in each loop of the campground', 'There is potable water provided throughout the campground and day use areas') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261822 ('There is no black or gray water dump on site, but there is one available for use at Black Sandy state park'), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM campground on the west shore of Hauser Lake at the mouth of Prickly Pear Creek, ~15 mi NE of Helena via the Lincoln Rd exit off I-15. Open shrub-steppe with little shade; every site has a lake and mountain view. Concrete boat launch with courtesy dock, beach, fish cleaning station; small general store across from the entrance. Dump station at Black Sandy SP 1/4 mi up the road. --Claude
summary: BLM-run (page: managed by the Montana/Dakotas State Office; no concessionaire), reservable on recreation.gov. Confirmed $25 (per camping unit), 32 sites, no power, vault toilets + potable water, no dump. Added 50-ft max (back-ins), 14-night limit. FCFS not recorded: BLM says reservations required, a rec.gov notice says FCFS sites exist. Not stated: season (rec.gov rate season May 1 - Sep 30 is not a season statement). No alerts. Note: 'Butte Field Office' dropped (the BLM page names the Montana/Dakotas State Office), restatements trimmed.
